parts.note: a brace is a pair, as of game birds
to let is to permit

explanation.surface: A pair of people are permitted to make jewellery.
explanation.definitionFit: A wrist ornament is a piece of jewellery.

indicators.note: say marks that the phrase is to be spoken, giving a sound-alike

parts.note: a cedilla is the hook written under the letter C, as in façade

explanation.surface: A typographical query about where a cedilla mark is placed.
explanation.walkthrough: The cedilla sits under C; spoken, 'under C' sounds like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Something below the waves is beneath the ocean's surface, which is to be submerged.

clue.text: A well-armed denizen of the deep

definitions.text: A well-armed denizen of the deep

parts.words: A well-armed denizen of the deep
parts.note: well-armed suggests weaponry but means having many limbs: this sea creature has eight

explanation.surface: A heavily armed creature lurking in the ocean.
explanation.definitionFit: This sea creature has eight tentacles, or arms, so is amply equipped with them.

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
MP is a Member of Parliament
end means death

explanation.surface: Someone menaces a politician with death.
explanation.definitionFit: To loom or hang over menacingly is to threaten.

definitions.meaning: as in I would ..., meaning preferably

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both fairly, to some degree, and preferably, as in would sooner.

parts.note: old is slang for mother or father, and a firm is a business, so a firm that is the old one in the family sense

explanation.surface: A nostalgic reference to a long-established business.
explanation.definitionFit: A holding business that owns subsidiaries is a progenitor firm in corporate terms.

parts.note: a common British theatre name, read instead as a London theatre named after a royal title

explanation.surface: A name seen on many British playhouses.
explanation.walkthrough: Many British towns have a Theatre Royal; here it is a West End theatre named after the heir to the British throne.
explanation.definitionFit: A London playhouse bears the heir apparent's title, so it is a theatre with a royal name.

parts.note: address suggests a speech or home, but here it is the form of words used to speak to a clergyman

explanation.surface: A government minister's speech or residence.
explanation.walkthrough: Minister suggests politics, but means a clergyman, and address is the courteous form for speaking to one.
explanation.definitionFit: A traditional honorific used when speaking to a member of the clergy.

parts.note: slip is liquid clay to a ceramicist, but a potter is also a snooker or pool player, whose slip is a bad shot

explanation.surface: Liquid clay used by a ceramicist.
explanation.walkthrough: In snooker, potting a ball sends it into a pocket, so a potter is the player.
explanation.definitionFit: A faulty stroke with the cue in snooker or billiards is a player's error.

definitions.meaning: to catch up with and go past, overtake
a thorough inspection and repair, as of an engine

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both to overtake and a full inspection and repair.

definitions.meaning: a commercial traveller, a sales representative
a ribbed fabric used in upholstery

explanation.definitionFit: The word is short for a sales representative and is also a ribbed woven fabric.

definitions.meaning: to go up, as a wall

explanation.definitionFit: The word means ascends and also weighing apparatus.

clue.text: How one may serve as subordinate member

parts.note: under means lower in rank
an arm is a limb, a member of the body

explanation.surface: A junior employee describing how they might be of service.
explanation.walkthrough: Serve suggests duty; it is a tennis or cricket delivery made with the hand below shoulder height.
explanation.definitionFit: A delivery with the hand below shoulder level is one way of putting the ball into play.

parts.note: not the stinging sea creature but a fish served set in jelly, a London Cockney dish

explanation.surface: A stinging marine creature.
explanation.walkthrough: Jellied eels are a traditional East London dish of chopped fish set in jelly.
explanation.definitionFit: This snakelike fish is commonly eaten jellied in London.

definitions.meaning: jokingly, a man who deals with feet

explanation.definitionFit: The word means a liveried servant and, read as two words, a feet specialist.

clue.text: Clean up and upset the Australian's Englishman

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset means the letters are turned upside down, read from bottom to top

parts.note: Pom is Australian slang for an English person

explanation.surface: Tidy up after annoying an Australian's English friend.
explanation.definitionFit: To wipe a floor with a sponge-headed tool is to clean up.

parts.note: suggests tax-free goods, but means releasing someone from a post by taking over

explanation.surface: Goods exempt from customs tax.
explanation.definitionFit: To take over a sentry's watch is to let them go from their post.

indicators.note: something blown to bits is shattered, so the letters of eternity are scattered and rebuilt

explanation.surface: All of eternity is destroyed.
explanation.definitionFit: The totality of something is the whole of it.

clue.text: Understood devil came to a valid end

parts.note: an imp is a little devil
licit means lawful, valid

explanation.surface: A demon meets a legitimate end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'came to a' and 'end' just join: the devil is followed by valid.
explanation.definitionFit: Something implied rather than stated is understood.

definitions.meaning: a gap or aperture in a wall
a chance, as in a job ...

explanation.definitionFit: The word means an aperture such as a doorway and also a chance.

parts.note: gathers dust usually means lies unused, but here someone literally collects dust with a brush

explanation.surface: Something lying neglected on a shelf.
explanation.definitionFit: Brushing debris into a pile collects the dirt from a floor.

indicators.note: to adjust is to alter, so the letters of height are altered into a new order

explanation.surface: Change the height of something very slightly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Adjust' rearranges HEIGHT; 'a fraction' looks like 'slightly' but is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: One part in eight is a fraction.

indicators.note: return means the word for first-class comes back, read from the end

parts.note: tops means the best
on means working, operating

explanation.surface: A first-class return ticket is running, which is great.
explanation.definitionFit: An exclamation meaning exactly right, perfect.

clue.text: Drunken repast comes to a fine end

indicators.note: drunken suggests staggering about, so the letters of repast are jumbled

explanation.surface: A boozy meal concludes nicely.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that narrows gradually to a point comes to a fine end.

clue.text: Priest from whom Samuel imbibed wisdom

definitions.text: Priest from whom Samuel imbibed wisdom

parts.words: Priest from whom Samuel imbibed wisdom
parts.note: the Old Testament priest at Shiloh who brought up the boy Samuel

explanation.surface: A Bible reference to Samuel's teacher.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Bible, the priest of Shiloh who raised and taught the young prophet Samuel.

clue.text: Stop when the standard is low

definitions.meaning: to signal a vehicle to halt
a standard is a banner, so the banner is lowered

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means to wave a vehicle to halt and, literally, a banner lowered.

indicators.note: breaks means the letters of singer are broken up and reassembled

explanation.surface: Regulations that a vocalist violates.
explanation.walkthrough: 'breaks' rearranges SINGER; 'Rules' is a verb, not a noun.
explanation.definitionFit: A monarch who governs is said to hold sway, to rule.

clue.text: People won't stand for this stoppage

definitions.text: People won't stand for this stoppage

parts.words: People won't stand for this stoppage
parts.note: won't stand for suggests refusing to tolerate, but here the protesting workers literally stay seated

explanation.surface: Workers refuse to tolerate an interruption to work.
explanation.definitionFit: An industrial protest in which workers occupy their workplace and stay seated.
